text:
aisha: Quick design review please — new "Relevance Inspector" panel in Vectors > Batch. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123 (see frame 'Inspector V2'). Main asks: sorting (score vs recency), export CTA wording, keyboard nav, and screen reader labels. Screenshots below. :eyes:

marco: Nice. Two quick layout q's — can we move the export button out of the overflow menu and make it a primary CTA? also the score column feels cramped.

liz: Copy thought: instead of "Export relevance", prefer "Download relevance CSV" or "Export results"? "Download" is clearer for users. maybe with a tiny hint: "Includes scores and vectors (ids)". 

jonathan: A11y: table needs role="grid" and each header should be focusable with aria-sort. Also keyboard shortcut for toggling sort would be great (e.g. press 's' when focus on table). Example:
```
<th aria-sort="none" tabindex="0">Score</th>
<button aria-label="Download relevance CSV">Download</button>
```

sam: Analytics: if we change CTA text we should track old vs new clicks to measure dropoff. Add event: "vectors_export_click" with prop export_label.

marco: layout option: two-column inspector (metadata left, vectors preview right) or stacked on mobile. if export is primary it should be left of the three-dot menu. mockup attached.

aisha: re: sorting — prefer default sort by score desc, but add a small toggle to 'Recent first' next to the column header. microcopy: "Sorted by relevance (score)" -> not too long.

jonathan: also color contrast: score chip (low/med/high) needs AA contrast. current green is too light on white.

liz: for the vector preview we need a compact row: id, snippet, score, preview icon. clicking preview opens modal with embeddings heatmap and raw vector download.

design-bot: Updated Figma with Marco's two-column layout and new CTA copy suggestions. https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123?node-id=42 :white_check_mark:

aisha: action items: 1) Marco to post updated mockups with export as primary, 2) Jonathan to paste aria snippets into the ticket, 3) Liz to finalize CTA text options A/B, 4) Sam to add tracking event. Deadline EOD Thu.

marco: will do mockups today. :zap:

jonathan: I'll open a tiny PR with aria attrs and keyboard handling examples.

liz: I'll add the copy variants to the ticket.

sam: I'll add the analytics spec and add the event to the console mapping.

aisha: thanks all — resolving when PR + mocks + analytics exist. :thumbsup:
